source: Paper Figures 5–7 and Appendix A.2, October 25, 2026 revision.
scope: 150 selected runs; 25 tasks per model. Totals below are rounded as printed in Figure 7.

definitions.visible_output: Recorded agent text and available tool-call content, tokenized with o200k_base. Excludes tool responses, repeated code-diff displays, and reasoning traces.
definitions.actions: One emitted text block or tool invocation, after deduplicating streamed events.
definitions.first_score: Wall-clock hours to the first valid scored private-test result, computed from the selected run histories.
definitions.totals: Whole-suite totals across all 25 selected runs for each model; these are not API input/output usage or per-run medians.
